title: Cleaner GUI
description: Clean GUI (Menu Only) — a minimal resource pack that modernizes Minecraft menus for a cleaner, distraction-free interface.
body:
🧼 Clean GUI (Menu Only)

Clean GUI is a minimal resource pack that redesigns Minecraft’s menus for a cleaner, modern look.
It simplifies menu backgrounds, buttons, and UI elements to reduce visual clutter while keeping everything familiar and readable.

✔ Menus only (no in-game textures changed)
✔ Lightweight & performance-friendly
✔ Works with SMPs and PvP setups

Perfect for players who want a polished interface without affecting gameplay visuals.
